The correct answer is: c

Now,

2005 to 2018 = 13 Years (10 Ordinary Years and 3 Leap Years).

So, 3 Leap Years have 6 odd days,

And, 10 Ordinary Years have 10 odd days.

Total odd days = 6 + 10 = 16.

16 odd days → 16/7 = 2 weeks and 2 odd days.

Then, 6 May 2018 will be Friday + 2 = Sunday.

Now, the number of days between 6 May 2018 and 25 September 2018

= 25(May) + 30(June) + 31(July) + 31(August) + 25(September) = 142 days.

= 142 days → 142/7 = 20 weeks and 2 odd days.

So, 25 September 2018 will be Sunday + 2 = Tuesday.
